classification.conformanceProfile: System V ELF / AMD64 bounded dynamically-linked executable release profile
classification.targetAuthority: ELF inspection plus sandbox runtime tool matrix

formatPolicy.artifactIdentity: exact SHA-256 and byte length of the final executable bytes
formatPolicy.elfType: ET_EXEC or PIE ET_DYN executable; exact object contract selects the expected type
formatPolicy.formatAuthority: ELF64/System V/AMD64 technical structure as exposed by mature libmagic and GNU binutils readelf
formatPolicy.producerBoundary: Artifact verifies final bytes only; source-to-binary build/export/reproducibility remains producer/Engineering authority
formatPolicy.runtimeReadback: Bubblewrap network namespace; exact release mounted read-only; /usr,/bin,/lib*,/etc read-only; ephemeral HOME/XDG state
formatPolicy.securityBoundary: runtime readback is not a claim of complete sandboxing or security isolation

nonClaims: that Artifact built the executable or owns source-to-binary reproducibility
complete filesystem, syscall or hostile-code sandbox isolation
SBOM, vulnerability absence, signature, provenance or attestation unless separately composed
code signing, notarization or platform-store package identity
caller-domain functional, artistic, player-value or commercial suitability

byteIdentity.claim: final executable SHA-256, byte length and executable mode match the exact object contract

contractSchema.claim: Linux ELF release object contract validates under software-release-linux-elf-contract-v1

elfStructure.claim: GNU readelf independently reports the contracted ELF class/data/OSABI/type/machine/interpreter facts

fileInspection.claim: libmagic/file independently recognizes the contracted ELF/Linux/x86-64 release class

runtimeReadback.claim: the exact final bytes execute under network-isolated Bubblewrap readback with read-only release/runtime substrate and ephemeral user state
